name: Severance Package
subtitle: Every departure comes with benefits. We're letting them go — and cashing in.

identity.mission: An Orzhov aristocrats machine. Staff up with expendable creatures and tokens, then process the layoffs — free sacrifice outlets feed a payroll of death triggers (drain, draw, tokens, counters), and Teysa Karlov signs off on each one twice. Every creature that leaves the company pays a dividend; do it enough and the table bleeds out while your books only grow. The deck should feel like ruthless, well-dressed corporate attrition — loss, monetized.

pillars.name: The Workforce
pillars.description: A wide, expendable roster — cheap creatures and token makers that exist to be spent. Bodies are inventory, not investment.

pillars.name: Processing the Layoffs
pillars.description: Free sacrifice outlets turn creatures into value on demand, and death-trigger payoffs (drain, draw, tokens, +1/+1 counters) collect on every departure.

pillars.name: Teysa Signs Off Twice
pillars.description: Teysa Karlov doubles every death trigger — each severance pays out twice. Recursion brings the workforce back to be spent again.

identity.selection_rule: Rarity alone never determines the definitive printing.
